text:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — I opened a tiny proposal for a preflight payload probe + granular-apply signal for low-bandwidth on‑prem installs. Wanted feedback on the envelope format and operator handshake.

tim: TL;DR? link?

maria: TL;DR — before transfer we send a compact preflight manifest that lists blobs + byte ranges + a small bloom for chunk existence. Operator verifies manifest signatures and then we stream blobs. During apply, the agent emits per-component apply events and a final activation marker. If any chunk is missing we abort and expose a resume token. RFC gist: https://rdrw/gists/preflight-probe (draft)

maria: example preflight snippet:```yaml
preflight_version: 1
components:
  - id: model-v1
    blobs: [m/v1/part-0, m/v1/part-1]
    ranges: [[0,1048576],[1048577,2097152]]
manifest_sig: sig_v1
```

anil: two quick concerns: 1) signatures — per-blob vs manifest-only? per-blob helps resume safety but increases signing ops. 2) activation atomicity — how do we avoid half-activated state if powercut after marker write?

maria: agree. proposal is per-blob lightweight signatures (ed25519) + a final manifest envelope signed by operator key. Activation flow: agent writes a staged-activation file in an atomic rename step, then updates the activation marker with sequence+sig. If powercut occurs before the marker, operator will detect stale staged files and either continue resume or garbage-collect after TTL.

jen: operator UX question — how do users inspect progress? need event stream with short codes so UI can show "applied 3/14 blobs, resuming". Also need a compact human-readable resume token we can paste into support tickets.

luca: we already have an event bus. propose event types: APPLY_STARTED, BLOB_RECEIVED(id), BLOB_APPLIED(id), APPLY_FAILED(reason), APPLY_RESUMABLE(resume_token). Resume token should be opaque base64 JSON: `{ver:2, comp:id, offset, manifest_hash}` signed by orchestration key. Keeps it idempotent.

maria: exactly — resume token example: `eyJ2IjoiMiIsIm0iOiJtLWUxIiwib2Zmc2V0IjoxMDQ4NTc2LCJoIjoi...` (signed). Agent side will accept token to patch missing ranges only. If token hash != manifest_hash we fail the resume and ask for full reinstall.

anil: edge case: registry dedupe — what if a blob referenced by two components is pruned mid-apply? we need a blob-lease during apply. operator should pin blob via short-term lease API.

maria: yes — plan: during preflight operator issues a lease for each blob id with a TTL = estimated apply time * 1.5. Lease extension is cheap. If lease lost -> APPLY_FAILED with reason=LEASE_EXPIRED.

jen: observability: add metrics: apply_bytes_total, apply_blobs_total, resume_attempts, resume_success_rate. Also trace ids on every resume token so SRE can join events.

luca: small implementation sketch for agent resume call:```http
POST /v1/agent/apply?resume_token=<token>
Body: { "patches": [{"blob":"m/v1/part-1","start":1048576,"end":2097152}]}
200 -> {"status":"resumed","applied":3} 409 -> {"status":"manifest_mismatch"}```

maria: love that. last bit: fallback policy. if resume attempts > 3 or missing > 25% of payload size, operator falls back to full rehydrate (re-download everything) or signals user for manual media (USB). We should document thresholds as knobs.

anil: +1. also add a quick developer test harness for flaky networks (kill connection mid-stream) so we can validate resume semantics.

tim: sounds good. can we get a short RFC PR with the manifest schema and event types? I'll shepherd. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: automated-check: preflight manifest schema validation failed on example (missing schema_version). See CI link: https://ci/runs/31415
